style: English acoustic folk pop, 96 BPM, clear solo female singing, warm acoustic guitar, gentle piano, soft brushed drums, melodic bass, intimate verses and a memorable chorus, natural expressive delivery, clear words, lead vocal prominent above the instruments, clean studio production
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The morning train has left the town
The rain is slowly coming down
I take my coat and close the door
Your letter waits upon the floor

[Chorus]
Keep a lantern by the road
I will find my way back home
Through the rain and through the cold
You are never on your own

[Verse 2]
The river runs beside the lane
The windows shine beyond the rain
I hear your laughter in the air
And turn to find you standing there

[Chorus]
Keep a lantern by the road
I will find my way back home
Through the rain and through the cold
You are never on your own

[Bridge]
We have walked so far together
We have watched the seasons turn
When the dark is all around us
There is still a light that burns

[Final Chorus]
Keep a lantern by the road
I will find my way back home
Through the rain and through the cold
You are never on your own
